en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: WWII partisan song, no author named, so translated. 'убај' is read as 'lovely, handsome' (my reading); 'балисти' refers to the Albanian nationalist Balli Kombetar.

lines.en: how handsomely they dress, mother, the partisans.
On their heads they wear lovely little caps

lines.cyr: на капчиња пише, мале, ај, да се борат.
lines.lat: na kapčinja piše, male, aj, da se borat.
lines.en: on the caps it says, mother, oh, to fight.

lines.cyr: Да се борат, мале, со фашистите
lines.lat: Da se borat, male, so fašistite
lines.en: To fight, mother, against the fascists

lines.cyr: со фашисти, мила мале, ај, со балисти.
lines.lat: so fašisti, mila male, aj, so balisti.
lines.en: against the fascists, dear mother, oh, against the Balists.
On their shoulders they carry Schmeissers

lines.cyr: па си отидоа, мале, ај, по шумите.
lines.lat: pa si otidoa, male, aj, po šumite.
lines.en: and so they went off, mother, oh, into the forests.

lines.cyr: Водач им беше, мале, маршал Тито
lines.lat: Vodač im beše, male, maršal Tito
lines.en: Their leader was, mother, Marshal Tito

lines.cyr: водач им беше, мале, ај, маршал Тито.
lines.lat: vodač im beše, male, aj, maršal Tito.
lines.en: their leader was, mother, oh, Marshal Tito.

lines.cyr: да соборат, мила мале, ај, возовите
lines.lat: da soborat, mila male, aj, vozovite
lines.en: to blow up, dear mother, oh, the trains

lines.cyr: да соборат, мила мале, ај, мостовите.
lines.lat: da soborat, mila male, aj, mostovite.
lines.en: to blow up, dear mother, oh, the bridges.
